Hi Markus / Janelle — quick finance note to clarify the VAT and remittance details so your AP team can proceed: 

- VAT: For U.S. invoiced business-to-business transactions we do not charge VAT. For EU-billed invoices: if your EU entity provides a valid VAT registration number and is the recipient of the supplies, we apply reverse-charge (0% VAT on our side) — you must record the VAT on your end. If you do not provide a VAT ID and the invoice is legally to an EU tax payer, we will need to assess VAT application. Please send the exact EU VAT ID you intend to use.

- Peppol: We accept Peppol e-invoices; our Peppol ID is 9901:REDWOODINFERENCE. You may also email PDFs to billing@redwood-invoice.com. If sending via Peppol, include the PO number and your supplier number in the invoice metadata.

- Vendor code creation: Once you return the completed onboarding form (the XLSX Neha attached), we will create a vendor code. Please include your supplier number (459887) in the form so we can map it into our system. Creation typically takes 1–2 business days after receipt.

- Bank details / remittance: Attached is a full bank details file including IBAN/SWIFT for international wires. Please validate with your bank for currency conversion.

Attachments:
- Completed_W9.pdf (application/pdf, 88 KB)
- Bank_Details_SWIFT.txt (text/plain, 1.2 KB)

If you want me to pre-populate any vendor-code field on the PO for matching, tell me the field name your system uses and I'll add it when we create the vendor.

Regards,
